prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. SQUARE image, requested 1024x1024.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Rounded expressive cartoon contours, large eyebrows and elastic mouths when faces are visible, opaque block-painted shapes and broad warm/cool color masses. Preserve muscular charm, orange/coral/turquoise palette and generous open sky. Expressive personality belongs only to subjects actually specified in this panel.
World context: Cream chalk ridge above green windmill hills; wooden caravan platforms and bright cloth sails to LEFT, broad safe grass hollow to RIGHT. A low wooden fence divides paths, with one wide openable gate.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Tavi Ember: Athletic adult woman, broad expressive face, teal eyes, warm light complexion, long asymmetric coral rope-like curls swept to one side with the other side closely cropped. Turquoise cropped vest over cream top, loose orange fighting trousers, red ankle wraps and cream boots. Equipment: Two rounded red gauntlets: anatomical RIGHT cream circle pressure plate; anatomical LEFT cream crescent. Cream waist belt and one detachable turquoise cloth padding strip. Current inventory controls cloth location, gauntlet damage and charge; do not default to an attached turquoise waist tail.
Mara: Light-skinned stocky female caravan captain, silver braid, ochre poncho, dark trousers, stout boots, small blue neck scarf. Amused pragmatist. Equipment: Plain rope halter and small tallybook. Any bell possession is governed by current inventory, not by her role as caravan captain.
Gale Ram: Living blue cloud-wool ram twice human height, cream muzzle, orange cheeks, curled blue horns, four stout legs and one cloud tail. Broad grouped wool shapes; no armor. Equipment: One plain brass signal bell about human-head height, with a wide opening and simple strap. The exact current inventory controls whether this bell is on the horn, a fence peg, in Mara’s hand or aboard the caravan. Never duplicate it.
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: For Tavi preserve the same long asymmetric coral rope-curl hairstyle and adult facial identity as this inspected sheet, consistently in every new panel. This documented pilot variation supersedes the draft short tuft only; no story or power rule changes.
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: Mara holds the recovered padded bell while the ram crouches its four legs to offer Tavi its back.
Current physical state (authoritative): Bell now returned to Mara; ram no longer carries it; gloves same damage; Tavi looking between mount and captain.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Wide comic reveal, whole ram crouch and caravan beyond. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
Reserve the upper 35% of the image as calm, broad in-world background for later speech balloons. Keep ALL faces, hands, important contact and clue details BELOW that zone. Do not draw balloons or text; the blank space will receive editable lettering.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Tavi Ember, Mara, Gale Ram may appear physically, with the stated crop. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
Anatomical RIGHT glove = cream CIRCLE; anatomical LEFT glove = cream CRESCENT. Follow shoulders through elbows to wrists, not screen-left/right. LEFT crescent glove has one exposed chipped outer knuckle edge; retain this same damage. RIGHT circle remains intact. Turquoise cloth is now tied as padding around bell clapper, not at Tavi’s waist. No second cloth tail on her; cream belt unchanged. The ONE padded brass bell is now held by Mara. Peg and ram horn are empty. RIGHT charge is absent/spent; no aura or hidden second charge.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Where the two-shot has no forced contact geography, place Mara toward image LEFT and Tavi toward image RIGHT to follow frozen reading order. Keep both faces below reserved lettering. Do not mirror anatomical equipment or power sides.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Wide comic reveal, whole ram crouch and caravan beyond. Depict only this instant: Mara holds the recovered padded bell while the ram crouches its four legs to offer Tavi its back. No added text or panel division.
